content.text: Users with browser timezone Pacific/Auckland who pick a calendar date on dashboard filter widgets (due date, created range) get a stored ISO date one calendar day earlier than the day they clicked.
Selecting 15 March should store 2026-03-15. Instead the control emits 2026-03-14T11:00:00.000Z and the chip displays 14 March after reopening the picker.

Conversion runs Date.UTC(y, m, d) after reading local Y/M/D, but an intermediate new Date(y, m, d) is serialized via toISOString() before the UTC rebuild, which shifts the day for UTC+12/+13 offsets. Building a plain date string YYYY-MM-DD without a Date instance until the API boundary would avoid the skew.
